title: UI accessibility & component-library review notes (console)
content:
Purpose and scope:
This working doc captures accessibility-focused notes and component library findings from our console/tooling audits (Nov 2025 - Feb 2026). Goal: produce a prioritized backlog that makes the Console’s components meet WCAG AA by default, improves keyboard and screen reader experience, and feeds concrete tickets into eng and design workstreams.

Audience:
- Console product designers and frontend engineers
- Design system owners (component library)
- SRE/QA owners for regression checks
- Accessibility reviewer (external audit later in Q2)

High-level summary / takeaways (TL;DR):
- Core components mostly usable, but numerous small gaps create degraded SR/keyboard flows for power users (modals, menus, table controls).
- Color token palette: several gray/secondary tokens fail contrast at small sizes. Need 2 token updates and a light-weight accessibility color palette audit.
- Focus management inconsistent: many compound components do not restore focus after dismiss, and dynamically injected panels lack focus traps.
- ARIA usage: overuse of role="presentation" in lists; missing live-region for long-running tasks (e.g., async model uploads) and ambiguous labeling on complex form groups.
- Quick wins available: add visible focus styles for inputs/buttons, ensure skiplinks to main content for keyboard users, and add aria-label fallbacks on icon-only buttons.

Audit notes by component (rough, iterative):
1) Buttons (primary/secondary/ghost)
- Observations: icon-only buttons used across token list, model cards; sometimes rely on title/tooltips alone. Focus ring present for primary, missing or visually weak on ghost buttons.
- A11y issues: no aria-label on some icon-only instances; small hit target in dense lists (32px).
- Recommendations: enforce 44px minimum tappable area for icon-buttons; require aria-label or aria-labelledby on icon-only variants via lint rule; standardize focus style (2px solid accent token + offset).
- Backlog entry: "BUTTONS-ACCESS-01 - icon-button aria-label lint + 44px min" (priority: P1, estimate: 1 dev day)

2) Dropdowns / Selects
- Observations: our custom select uses role=combobox in some places and role=listbox in others. Keyboard handling inconsistent (Arrow keys sometimes close instead of move selection).
- A11y issues: no explicit aria-controls/aria-expanded linkage on a11y-critical flows. Screen reader reads selected item twice in multi-select.
- Recommendations: standardize on ARIA 1.2 patterns for combobox vs listbox; add an automated keyboard test harness for selects; create a11y acceptance criteria for selects in PR template.
- Backlog: "SELECT-ACCESS-02 - standardize select role/keyboard + tests" (P1, 2 dev days)

3) Modals & Panels
- Observations: nested modal flows (device connect -> modal -> inner dialog) break focus traps. Side panels used for long-running operations do not hide inert background.
- A11y issues: focus sometimes lands behind the modal; ESC closes modal but focus not restored to originating trigger.
- Recommendations: implement reusable focus-trap wrapper in component library; add helper for save/restore focus anchor; ensure inert attribute/aria-hidden toggles on background nodes; add visual focus-visible outlines inside modals.
- Backlog: "MODAL-ACCESS-03 - focus trap + restore helper" (P0, 3 dev days)

4) Tables and data grids
- Observations: large tables (model catalog, logs) rely on dense controls and small touch targets; row selection is ambiguous to screen readers.
- A11y issues: missing aria-sort on sortable headers; missing summary/aria-describedby for table purpose; poor keyboard paging support.
- Recommendations: add aria-sort, ensure header cells use scope="col", ensure visible row focus styling, add announced status when page changes (aria-live polite).
- Backlog: "TABLE-ACCESS-07 - table semantics + keyboard paging" (P1, 2 dev days)

5) Toasts and notifications
- Observations: toasts appear in top-right with no explicit live-region; long-running progress toasts are silent.
- A11y issues: SR users not notified of success/failure consistently; some error toasts removed before SR can read them.
- Recommendations: add aria-live polite region for toasts; add role="status" for success and role="alert" only for errors needing immediate attention; extend visible duration before remove or provide a stop/hide control.
- Backlog: "TOAST-ACCESS-04 - live region + duration policy" (P2, 1 dev day)

6) Forms and field groups
- Observations: complex forms (model deployment steps) use visually apparent headings but missing fieldset/legend semantics for groups. Error messages sometimes displayed visually but not linked via aria-describedby.
- A11y issues: SR users may not understand groupings; inline validation not announced.
- Recommendations: use fieldset/legend for grouped options; ensure input aria-invalid and error id references; standardize error message component that ties into input via aria-describedby.
- Backlog: "FORM-ACCESS-05 - error linking + fieldset patterns" (P1, 1.5 dev days)

Design tokens & colors (high level):
- Quick audit run against current color tokens: secondary-gray-400 and gray-300 fail AA at 12px text on light theme.
- Recommendations: create an accessibility-adjusted token set (tokens.accessible.*) for components that render small text (e.g., helper text, captions).
- Backlog: "TOKENS-ACCESS-09 - color token audit + accessible variants" (P1, 2 dev days)

Keyboard navigation & focus management:
- Must-haves: consistent tab order, clear visible focus for keyboard-only users, skip-to-main link on console shells, predictable focus after route changes.
- Failing cases found: dynamic panels opened by screen actions (e.g., filter drawer) do not trap focus; pressing Escape sometimes only closes child element but leaves focus in wrong place.
- Recommendation: adopt a small runtime focus-manager utility in the component library that:
  - provides focusTrap(container, options)
  - provides restoreFocus(handle)
  - exposes helpers for route-change focusing (focusMain())
- Backlog: "FOCUS-UTIL-11 - component library focus-manager" (P0, 4 dev days)

Screen reader patterns & aria hygiene checklist (proposal to add to PR template):
- Icon-only controls: must have aria-label or aria-labelledby
- Modal: focus trap + return focus + aria-modal="true"
- Dynamic lists: use role=list / role=listitem where semantics needed; avoid role=presentation on interactive items
- Status updates: use aria-live with appropriate politeness and role mapping
- Form errors: input aria-invalid + aria-describedby -> error id
- Keyboard-only operations must support shift+tab and arrow navigation where appropriate

Testing strategy (short-term and longer-term):
- Short-term (Q1-Q2): add unit-level a11y checks + jest-axe for key components; add Cypress a11y plugin for a small set of smoke flows (login -> open model card -> open modal -> submit).
- Longer-term (Q3+): integrate pa11y / axe-core in CI for critical release branches; schedule external screen reader audit with a11y consultancy for high-traffic flows.

Wireframe / UX notes (component-level behavior changes):
- Filter drawer: should slide in with role="dialog" and trap focus; when opened from table, focus first interactive control (filter search) and ensure 'Apply' is reachable via keyboard shortcuts (Alt+A) as optional enhancement.
- Batch actions toolbar (table): keyboard only flow should expose a visible selection summary and a clear 'Apply to selected' action with aria-controls to the bulk action panel.
- Sidebar navigation: add skip links (invisble until focused) and ensure nested headings have aria-expanded on toggle affordances.

Backlog grooming (prioritization + owner suggestions):
- P0 (security/critical UX): MODAL-ACCESS-03 (Maya/Samir)
- P1 (high impact): BUTTONS-ACCESS-01 (Samir), SELECT-ACCESS-02 (Elena), FORM-ACCESS-05 (Jonah)
- P1 (tokens): TOKENS-ACCESS-09 (Design lead)
- P2 (nice-to-have): TOAST-ACCESS-04 (Frontend intern)

Acceptance criteria examples (to copy into tickets):
- For modal focus trap: Given a modal opened from a button, when modal is active, tab must cycle inside modal, screen reader should announce modal heading on open, ESC closes and focus returns to original trigger.
- For icon-button aria-label: given an icon-only button in the UI kit, the component must fail build-time lint if aria-label/aria-labelledby not provided; storybook stories must include a11y knobs.

Open questions and edge cases (needs design input):
- How do we treat toasts for ephemeral model logs that repeatedly update? Should we consolidate to a single live region that re-reads summary only?
- For dark-mode contrast adjustments, do we want separate tokens per-theme or a contrast-correcting tool in the token pipeline?
- Do we expose keyboard shortcuts (global) in the product? If yes, need discovery & conflict resolution strategy.

Next steps (practical):
1) Convert backlog items above into individual Jira tickets (owner + estimates included).
2) Add a11y checklist to PR template and storybook component templates.
3) Implement two quick wins this sprint: icon-button aria-lint + focus visible styles for ghost buttons.
4) Schedule design token audit with design (Dec-Jan) and follow-up token PR.
5) Plan external SR audit for mid-Q2.

Notes to reviewers (meta):
- This is intentionally granular and partial — many components will need iterative passes.
- Please annotate this doc with Figma frame links for any component you intend to own; add estimated dev owner if you can.
- If you want to split a backlog item into smaller pieces, mark with subtask tag.

Quick references (internal):
- Console design tokens: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/CONSOLE/Design+Tokens
- Component library repo: github.com/redwood-inference/console-ui
